description: This file defines the configuration structures for the Swabble project, including nested structures for audio, wake, hook, logging, transcripts, and speech settings. It also provides functionality for loading and saving configuration data from and to a JSON file, along with associated error handling.

methods.name: load(at:)
methods.description: Loads a SwabbleConfig instance from a specified file URL, throwing an error if the file does not exist or if decoding fails.

methods.name: save(_:at:)
methods.description: Encodes and saves a SwabbleConfig instance to a specified file URL, creating necessary directories.
